method.caveat: Checks share records and orders, so they are not independent; coverage rates are descriptive and carry wide sampling error.
method.outcome_sampling: sequential binomial draws of stage survivors on the target record count, using the resampled chain conditionals
method.parameter_uncertainty: refit the estimator on paired bootstrap resamples of profiling rows
method.pit: mid-PIT: P(draw < observed) + 0.5 * P(draw = observed); uniform when calibrated
